objective: Independent security review of PR1 (hook observation gating and SessionStart stdin handling) and PR6 (CI step fetching Claude Code via bunx; architecture guard).
acceptance_criteria: PR1: confirms the PreToolUse guard's allow/deny decisions are unchanged for every agent (only recording changed), that a payload cannot use a crafted agent_type to suppress the core rules or skew verify in a way that matters, and that the new SessionStart stdin read is bounded and fails safe.

PR6: assesses the supply-chain exposure of fetching a pinned npm package in CI (version pin vs integrity, permissions of the job, token exposure via persist-credentials, network), and whether the guard test reads only repo files.
Each finding traced source to sink with severity, or stated as none.
result: Security review PR1+PR6: no finding at medium or above. PR1: guard decisions unchanged, payloads only from Claude Code, rule omission fails toward injecting, verify tightened; L1 specialist without agent_type on start loses observation (documented to be sent); I1 bare holyclaude name acceptable but strict qualified name preferred; I2 stdin slice buffering unconfirmed. PR6: pinned bunx fetch lacks integrity hash (low; read-only token, pull_request trigger, persist-credentials false); guard reads only repo files.

acceptance.rationale: Traced source to sink for each concern from the diffs and code; limits of reading stated.

criteria_evidence.Each finding traced source to sink with: L1, I1, I2, PR6 low each traced with severity.
